# Copilot Instructions

Project Synapse is currently focused on Phase 1: a Rust CLI LAN proof of concept for sharded AI inference.

Before suggesting changes, use `docs/AI_CONTEXT.md` and `docs/skills/synapse-lan-poc/SKILL.md` as the source of truth. Keep code under `crates/`, docs under `docs/`, and config under `config/`. Do not introduce Phase 2 or Phase 3 features yet.
